purpose: Controlled reason-code vocabulary for PFAS QA/QC decision traces.

reason_codes.description: Calibration fit or point-level acceptance criteria not met.
reason_codes.typical_trigger: r2 < threshold or %D exceeds method allowance

reason_codes.description: Isotope-labeled internal-standard response drifted beyond control window.
reason_codes.typical_trigger: IS area outside rolling median control limits

reason_codes.description: Surrogate recovery outside lane-defined acceptance envelope.
Method blank signal suggests potential contamination carryover.
Field blank indicates possible sampling or transport contamination.
Reagent blank contains low-level PFAS indication requiring trend tracking.
Replicate precision indicates unstable quantitation.
Duplicate sample disagreement exceeds accepted RPD threshold.
Sample exceeded matrix/analyte holding-time requirement.
Required chain-of-custody metadata is missing or inconsistent.
Result cannot be interpreted due to missing or invalid units.
Declared matrix is not compatible with applied method context.
Observed mass error exceeds acceptance criterion.
Observed retention time departs from expected/predicted envelope.
MS/MS evidence is insufficient for confident assignment.
Observed adduct pattern conflicts with expected chemistry.
Composite confidence score below release threshold.
Required provenance/metadata fields are incomplete.
Automatic policy requires human reviewer sign-off before release.
Reviewer approved release with documented caveats.

composition_rules: Every decision record must include at least one reason_codes entry.
If decision class is fail, at least one fail-class reason code is required.
If reason_codes contains method_blank_contamination_detected, decision class cannot be pass.
release_approved_with_conditions requires reviewer_id and reviewer_note fields in decision record.
